text:
Priya (CS): FYI — we're getting reports that a subset of EU dedicated pool customers' onboarding jobs are stuck at 'indexing' with intermittent 502s and timeouts since ~02:08 UTC. Seen in trial and high-touch accounts.
Liam (SRE): I see a network partition event on the eu-dedicated-cluster at 02:06. Some worker nodes lost connectivity to the KV caching layer, causing backlog and retries.
Noah (Eng): Confirmed. KV cache misses + request retries flooded the ingress, causing 502s and slow completions for ingest pipelines.
Priya (CS): Which customer segments are impacted? any with active renewals or exec contacts?
Sofia (CS Manager): I flagged 5 high-touch onboarders with exec-level contacts (two pilots, one renewal next month). Need coordinated comms ASAP.
Mateo (Sales): Please tag me when you have a customer-facing note. I'll prep the account-level touchpoints and loop in AMs.
Liam (SRE): Mitigation in progress: we're routing new onboarding traffic to fallback hosting pool in eu-west while we heal dedicated nodes. Rolling config now (ETA 10m).
Priya (CS): Good — can we confirm fallback preserves data isolation for VPC customers? That matters for some GDPR/restrictions.
Noah (Eng): VPC customers can't be routed to shared-hosted fallback. For those, we're doing a targeted requeue of ingest jobs once KV layer recovers + priority reingest.
Priya (CS): Ok. For affected VPC accounts we need an explicit plan + timing in the comm. Draft suggestion: brief status, why (network partition on dedicated pools), mitigation (fallback or queued reingest), ETA, exec contact line, and credit offer.
Sofia (CS Manager): Agreed. Priya, please draft a short customer note and tag Mateo. Keep it <4 bullets.
Priya (CS): Drafting now — sharing below for quick review.
Priya (CS): ```
Hi <Customer Team>,
Short update: we observed a network partition impacting dedicated inference/indexing pools in the EU region starting 02:06 UTC, which caused onboarding indexing jobs to stall for some accounts.
What we did: routed new non-VPC onboarding traffic to a fallback hosted pool; for VPC/on-prem accounts we queued safe, prioritized reingest once KV layer is healthy.
ETA: we expect recovery and prioritized completion within 30–60 minutes.
Next steps: we'll send a confirmation when your onboarding is complete and offer a one-time credit for the disruption. For urgent needs, please reply to this thread or book a 1:1 here: <cal link>.
Thanks,
Priya on behalf of Redwood Inference Ops
```
Liam (SRE): +1. Add a bullet about "no customer data was exposed" for reassurance.
Priya (CS): Added. Updated draft and sending to Mateo for account personalization.
Mateo (Sales): Got it. I'll add customer-specific notes and exec contact lines for the 5 flagged accounts. I'll also ask AMs to prioritize outreach for the renewal lead.
Sofia (CS Manager): Let's also schedule a 30-min office hours tomorrow for any impacted customers who want live walkthroughs. Put it in the community calendar and mention it in the comms.
Priya (CS): Will do. Also starting a quick internal triage doc to capture impacted tenants, severity, assigned AM/CS owner, and credit amounts.
Noah (Eng): Root cause postmortem: looking like a bad routing update + delayed health-checks on the KV replicas. We'll keep the postmortem timeline tight — initial RCA within 24h and full RCA within 72h.
Liam (SRE): Healing completed at 02:28 UTC. KV layer re-synced; requeue agent started. We're monitoring token throughput; still watching.
Priya (CS): Last ask — can ops-bot post a synthesized list of impacted accounts and status when requeue finishes? That will make the customer list authoritative.
ops-bot: Impacted accounts list will be posted to this thread when requeue job finishes. (automated) :gear:
Mateo (Sales): Thanks team. I'll coordinate personalized notes and reconvene in 30m for status.
Sofia (CS Manager): Great work — once we send outbound comms, please paste the sent message here so we have an audit trail. :thumbsup:
Priya (CS): Will do. Updating thread as we get the ops-bot list.
ops-bot: Requeue finished at 02:34 UTC — posting impacted accounts now: account-a, account-b, account-c, account-d, account-e. (automated)
Priya (CS): Copy — sending emails to account contacts now, starting with the highest-risk renewal. I'll BCC CS SLT.
Noah (Eng): We'll follow up with the RCA draft and suggested mitigations (stronger health-checks + throttled ingress during cache flaps).
Sofia (CS Manager): Keep customer-facing language simple. Focus on impact, what we did, ETA, and support. No technical jargon in the initial comm.
Priya (CS): Understood. Sending out initial comms and scheduling the follow-up office hours invite.
Mateo (Sales): I'll update AMs and prep renewal exec talking points.
Priya (CS): Done — pasted the sent note below for the audit trail.
Priya (CS): ```
Sent to account-a: 
Subject: Brief update: onboarding delay (we fixed it)
Body: Hi <Name>,
Quick update: we had a brief infrastructure partition impacting dedicated EU onboarding pools which caused your indexing to stall. We've prioritized your reingest and expect completion within the hour. No customer data was exposed. We're applying a one-time account credit. If you want a live walkthrough, here's a 30-min slot: <link>.
Thanks,
Priya
```
Liam (SRE): Thx. Close monitoring for next 2 hrs then mark incident as resolved if stable.
Priya (CS): Marking this task done on CS side after all affected accounts receive confirmation. Closing thread once RCA is posted.
Sofia (CS Manager): Thanks everyone.
